headline: Callahan's Passage Leads as Nevish Line Falls Silent
war_summary: Since the midday wire the Nevish Line has fallen silent with no changes in the past two hours after eleven in six around Princefal, holding at six Warden to two Colonial, while Fisherman's Row has cooled to a single change in two hours though fifty-seven on the day across nine Colonial holdings. Callahan's Passage now leads the wire with five changes in two hours and sixty-nine on the day about The Latch at eight Warden to two Colonial, with day losses of 12,714 Colonial and 14,644 Warden. Stlican Shelf shows two changes in two hours and fifty-two on the day about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost at two Warden, six Colonial and one destroyed, with accelerating casualty rates. Viper Pit reports three changes in two hours, all nine on the day at Moltworth under eight Warden holdings with the latest filing at the hour. The Weathered Expanse and Mooring County record no changes in two hours despite heavy day casualties.
